name: Torrents-csv-android
blurb: Torrents-csv-android is a search engine for the torrents-csv.com search engine.
description:
Torrents-csv-android is a search engine for the torrents-csv.com search engine.

Torrents.csv is a collaborative repository of torrents and their files, consisting of a searchable torrents.csv file. With it you can search for torrents, or files within torrents. It aims to be a universal file system for popular data.

install.label: F-Droid
install.note: Adds F-Droid as an update source, so you keep getting updates.
